stash.stashRequiresRepositoryPathsEncode.en: Stash requires repository paths encoded as UTF-8.
stash.stashRequiresRepositoryPathsEncode.zh-CN: Stash 要求仓库路径使用 UTF-8 编码。

stash.cannotSafelyInspectAPathBelowASymb.en: Cannot safely inspect a path below a symbolic link: {{name}}
stash.cannotSafelyInspectAPathBelowASymb.zh-CN: 无法安全检查符号链接下的路径：{{name}}

stash.cannotSafelySnapshotThisFileUnsupp.en: Cannot safely snapshot this file (unsupported type or larger than 32 MiB): {{name}}
stash.cannotSafelySnapshotThisFileUnsupp.zh-CN: 无法安全创建此文件的快照（类型不受支持或大于 32 MiB）：{{name}}

stash.stashPreflightIsNotSupportedInASpa.en: Stash preflight is not supported in a sparse checkout. Use Git directly for this repository.
stash.stashPreflightIsNotSupportedInASpa.zh-CN: 稀疏检出不支持 Stash 预检。请直接使用 Git 处理此仓库。

stash.stashIsolationCannotSaveOrRestoreA.en: Stash isolation cannot save or restore a submodule state. Use Git directly for this path.
stash.stashIsolationCannotSaveOrRestoreA.zh-CN: Stash 隔离无法保存或恢复子模块状态。请直接使用 Git 处理此路径。

stash.stashIsolationNeedsGit243OrNewerTo.en: Stash isolation needs Git 2.43 or newer to inspect attribute sources.
stash.stashIsolationNeedsGit243OrNewerTo.zh-CN: Stash 隔离需要 Git 2.43 或更高版本才能检查属性来源。

stash.cannotSafelySnapshotASymbolicLinkU.en: Cannot safely snapshot a symbolic link used as an attribute source: {{name}}
stash.cannotSafelySnapshotASymbolicLinkU.zh-CN: 无法安全创建用作属性来源的符号链接快照：{{name}}

stash.cannotSafelyInspectTheDirectoryOcc.en: Cannot safely inspect the directory occupying {{name}}. Move it before restoring.
stash.cannotSafelyInspectTheDirectoryOcc.zh-CN: 无法安全检查占用 {{name}} 的目录。请在恢复前将其移走。

stash.theWorkingStateIsLargerThanThe128M.en: The working state is larger than the 128 MiB Stash preflight limit. Use Git directly for this repository.
stash.theWorkingStateIsLargerThanThe128M.zh-CN: 工作状态超过 128 MiB 的 Stash 预检限制。请直接使用 Git 处理此仓库。

stash.stashIsolationCannotSafelyRunAnExt.en: Stash isolation cannot safely run an external {{attribute}} driver for {{name}}. Use Git directly for this file.
stash.stashIsolationCannotSafelyRunAnExt.zh-CN: Stash 隔离无法安全地为 {{name}} 运行外部 {{attribute}} 驱动。请直接使用 Git 处理此文件。

stash.stashIsolationCannotRunAnExternalD.en: Stash isolation cannot run an external default merge driver. Use Git directly for this repository.
stash.stashIsolationCannotRunAnExternalD.zh-CN: Stash 隔离无法运行外部默认合并驱动。请直接使用 Git 处理此仓库。

stash.finishTheActiveGitOperationOrResol.en: Finish the active Git operation or resolve existing conflicts before restoring a Stash. The Index and Working Tree were not changed.
stash.finishTheActiveGitOperationOrResol.zh-CN: 恢复 Stash 前，请完成当前 Git 操作或解决现有冲突。Index 和工作区均未更改。

stash.stashRestorationFailedInTheIsolate.en: Stash restoration failed in the isolated trial.
stash.stashRestorationFailedInTheIsolate.zh-CN: Stash 在隔离试验中恢复失败。

stash.theStashCouldNotBeRestoredInTheIso.en: The Stash could not be restored in the isolated trial. The real Index and Working Tree were not changed, and the Stash is still saved.
stash.theStashCouldNotBeRestoredInTheIso.zh-CN: 无法在隔离试验中恢复 Stash。实际 Index 和工作区均未更改，Stash 仍然保留。

stash.theProjectChangedDuringStashInspec.en: The project changed during Stash inspection. Refresh and retry. This restore did not change the Index or Working Tree.
stash.theProjectChangedDuringStashInspec.zh-CN: 项目在检查 Stash 期间发生变化。请刷新后重试；此次恢复未更改 Index 或工作区。

stash.stashPreflightCouldNotCompleteTheI.en: Stash preflight could not complete. The Index and Working Tree were not changed.
stash.stashPreflightCouldNotCompleteTheI.zh-CN: Stash 预检未能完成。Index 和工作区均未更改。

stash.theSelectedFileNoLongerHasChangesR.en: The selected file no longer has changes: {{name}}. Refresh and select it again.
stash.theSelectedFileNoLongerHasChangesR.zh-CN: 所选文件已没有更改：{{name}}。请刷新后重新选择。

stash.theProjectChangedWhileCreatingTheS.en: The project changed while creating the Stash. No files were cleaned; refresh and retry.
stash.theProjectChangedWhileCreatingTheS.zh-CN: 项目在创建 Stash 期间发生变化。没有清理任何文件；请刷新后重试。

stash.theStashWasSavedButTheProjectChang.en: The Stash was saved, but the project changed before cleanup. The files were left in place.
stash.theStashWasSavedButTheProjectChang.zh-CN: Stash 已保存，但项目在清理前发生变化。文件已保留在原处。

stash.theStashWasSavedAndRetainedButClea.en:
The Stash was saved and retained, but cleanup did not complete. Inspect the remaining files.
{{value}}
stash.theStashWasSavedAndRetainedButClea.zh-CN:
Stash 已保存并保留，但清理未完成。请检查剩余文件。
{{value}}
